purpose: Demonstrate the complete post-period Q3 review workflow without changing authoritative Data B dates or current-quarter truth.
data_rules: Do not alter Q3 Goal/KPI progress; read the live governed Q3 goals from PostgreSQL.
Formal criterion scores in this fixture are demonstration evaluator inputs, not an automatic conversion of Goal/KPI percentages.
Finalized and calibration records are simulated inside the valid Oct 1-Oct 15 Q3 review window.
Admin/HR governs calibration and may return a review for revision; Admin does not casually overwrite evaluator ratings.
